sections.title: What You'll Learn
sections.content:
Ready to learn **Introduction to Loops**?

Here's what we'll cover:

• Overview of loop structures
• Why this matters for your coding journey
• Hands-on examples you can try

sections.title: Core Concepts
sections.content:
Think of **Introduction to Loops** like building blocks. 

Every great program starts with small, simple pieces. This is one of those essential pieces!

• Start simple, then build up
• Practice makes it click
• Don't worry if it takes time - totally normal!

sections.title: Code Examples
Key Points
points: A loop repeats a block of code while a condition remains true
Java provides three loop types: while, do-while, and for
Loops are essential for processing repeated tasks, collections, and user input
Every loop needs a condition that eventually becomes false to avoid infinite loops
The loop body is the block of code that executes on each iteration

sections.title: Summary
sections.content: Introduction to Loops - Overview of loop structures. Master basics before advancing. Practice with the examples. Builds foundation for what's next.

questions.question: What is the primary purpose of a loop in programming?
options: To repeat a block of code multiple times
questions.explanation: Loops are control structures that repeat a block of code multiple times based on a condition. They help avoid writing repetitive code.

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a loop structure in Java?
questions.explanation: if-else is a selection (decision) statement, not a loop. Java's three loop structures are while, for, and do-while.
